content.text: Bayern Munich v Atalanta: the line-ups | UCL Round of 16 2nd leg18 March 2026share-facebookshare-xshare-whatsappshare-copy-link21:00 CET kick-off in MunichHere are the official line-ups for Bayern Munich v Atalanta, the second leg of our 2025/26 UEFA Champions League Round of 16 tie kicking off at 21:00 CET at the Fußball Arena München in Munich: Bayern Monaco: Urbig, Stanisic, Tah, Kim, Bischof, Goretzka, Pavlovic, Karl, Guerreiro, Luis Diaz, Kane. Bench: Bartl, Prescott, Upamecano, Gnabry, Jackson, Ito, Laimer, Deniz Ofli, Manuba, Pasoc. Coach: Vincent Kompany. Atalanta: Sportiello, Kossounou, Hien, Scalvini, Bellanova, Pašalić, Éderson, Bernasconi, De Ketelaere, Scamacca, Kamaldeen. Bench: Carnesecchi, Rossi, Bakker, Samardžić, de Roon, Raspadori, Djimsiti, Kolašinac, Zalewski, Ahanor, Zappacosta, Krstović. Coach: Raffaele Palladino. Referee: Benoit Bastien (FRA); Assistant referees: Hicham Zakrani (FRA) and Aurélien Berthomieu (FRA); Fourth official: Mathieu Vernice (FRA); V.A.R. Bastien Dechepy (FRA); A.V.A.R.
